messages:
maria.p: Quick follow-ups from the all-hands — trying to align timing for API / Console / Optimize so teams can plan. Can folks reply here with concrete canary windows, beta acceptance criteria, SDK/docs parity, and owners for follow-ups?

alex.g: High level: aim is to ship the API streaming + function-calls GA by end of Q2. Console per-route dashboards go beta in early Q3. Optimize recommendations engine: beta by late Q2, GA in Q3. Will post more granular owners below.

ken: Canary plan we expect for network-facing changes: start at 5% -> 10% over 48h, then steady for 14 days at 10% before ramp. Success = stable p95, no significant regressions on quality evals, errors <0.5%.

olivia: SDK parity: JS + Python will be feature-complete for the new API at GA. Go + Java SDKs targeted for GA+1 sprint. Docs: migration guide and sample repos published at beta start.

sam: Quick q re rollback triggers — is the plan manual or automated? what exact thresholds?

ken: We'll automate hard rollbacks for spikey errors. Thresholds (draft):
```
canary:
  initial_pct: 5
  target_pct: 10
  steady_days: 14
  rollback_if:
    p95_latency_increase_pct: 15
    errors_per_min_multiplier: 3
    eval_quality_drop_pct: 5
```
These are configurable per-rollout.

rachael: Acceptance criteria for beta (Optimize): must pass: latency SLO (service-specific), recommendation precision hit on our eval suite (no >5% regressions), docs and a minimal migration guide, and observability (per-route metrics + alerting). Owner: @maria.p for product, @ken for infra, @olivia for docs.

maria.p: I'll own the follow-up tracking doc. Action items: ken to write a short canary runbook, olivia to draft SDK parity checklist, rachael to finalize beta success metrics. Can volunteers help QA the migration guide? @sam?

sam: I can take initial QA pass on the migration guide next week. Also will set up an oncall playbook for canary alerts.

olivia: Will open a docs PR by EOD Friday with checklist & templates.

alex.g: A couple of clarifications: GA targets are contingent on no major regressions in the next eval pass (running now). If eval flags anything, we'll delay GA by one sprint and expand canary.

deploy-bot: Note: created tracking issue #INF-992 in the roadmap board for these action items.

ken: One more item — fallback model policy: during canary we keep a compatible lower-capacity variant for instant fallback; teams please test fallback paths.

rachael: Great, thanks. I'll circulate the combined timeline & owners doc tomorrow. If anyone thinks the windows are too aggressive, reply here — we can re-scope features into GA+1. :thumbsup:

maria.p: thanks all — this is helpful. I'll update the all-hands notes with owners + links once rachael posts the doc.
